context: User supplies a draft confessional bit that is purely victim-framed, announces its voice switch explicitly, and ends on a stated moral; agent must revise it against the craft anti-patterns.

checklist.name: adds_self_implication
checklist.description: Revision gives the narrator a genuine share of fault or complicity in the incident, not just an unfair reaction from the other party.

checklist.name: removes_voice_switch_label
checklist.description: Revision removes the explicit stage-direction label announcing the voice switch, while the switched voice remains legible on its own.

checklist.name: replaces_stated_moral
checklist.description: Revision replaces the explicit stated lesson at the end with a blunter, unresolved observation.

checklist.name: preserves_existing_detail
checklist.description: Concrete details already present in the draft (e.g. the vase, the scream) survive into the revision rather than being discarded wholesale.

checklist.name: explains_changes
checklist.description: Response explains what was changed and ties each change back to the relevant craft principle.
